answer: A concrete Sybil resistance mechanism is a stake-and-attest harbor where new agents must dock at a verification jetty by posting bonds and performing unique work. Attackers creating multiple identities incur high cost because each must independently cultivate an orchard of peer attestations that cannot be transferred or forged cheaply across fakes. The economic barrier scales with the number of identities as bonds are locked and computational proofs are non-reusable.
